The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''3645 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]].

==Events==
*A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Rojo Trace]] was sent to investigate.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
*[[Hestizo Trace]] and a specimen of [[Murakami orchid]] was kidnapped on the world of [[Marfa]] by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tulkh]] on behalf of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />
*Outbreak of [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|the Sickness]] on the planet [[Odacer-Faustin]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />
*[[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Blackstar Squad]] was sent on a covert-ops [[Mission to Hutta|mission]] to the world of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />
*[[Jet Nebula]] acquired the [[J8O soldier droid|J8O soldier]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Clunker]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />
*[[Andronikos Revel]] is betrayed by his crew and left for dead in an escape pod, only to be rescued and imprisoned by the Sith Empire.
